goal: Recover the most likely original non-minigame Mario Party 6 source while preserving retail binary identity as the final verification gate.

evidence_hierarchy.description: Same-game debug information, map data, symbols, source remnants, or authenticated binary artifacts.
Target instructions, relocations, access widths, sections, call contracts, strings, and object layout.
Same-game callers, consumers, archives, messages, data domains, and ownership relationships.
Closely related Hudson or Mario Party source used as supporting, not overriding, evidence.
Controlled compiler experiments that prove source shape but not semantic meaning.
A provisional interpretation retained only when stronger evidence is absent.

agent_contract: Recover the most likely original source; do not optimize only for emitted bytes.
Binary identity is required for final promotion but is not, by itself, a source-authenticity claim.
Same-game target and consumer evidence outrank sibling source, compiler probes, and readability hypotheses.
The AI workspace is permanent and must never be merged, squashed, rebased, or cherry-picked into main.
Only exact verified src/**/*.c blobs may be promoted automatically to a fresh recovery/* branch based on main.
Claim the owner and every shared write path before editing; the real Git diff must remain inside the claim.
Consult automatically selected knowledge cards, freshness state, symptoms, and counterexamples before starting a compiler probe.
Compiler experiments may justify source shape; they do not prove semantic names.
Do not invent names, types, padding, globals, branches, or literal domains.
Do not regress independently exact functions or consumers.
Every unusual source construct must be authenticated, temporary debt, or rejected.
Blind benchmarks must freeze candidates before reveal and score assembly, retained-source fidelity, organicity, and reproducibility separately.
acceptance_criteria: Start with evidence research and a natural source candidate before compiler reconciliation.
Review applicable rules, constraints, freshness warnings, and counterexamples before repeating a probe.
Keep every changed path inside the active claim and outside other active claims.
Record semantic names and types with evidence and confidence.
Bind worker verification proof to a clean current commit.
Run relocation-aware owner and consumer comparisons.
Run serialized retail checksum and byte gates before integration finalization.
Update source-quality dimensions independently from binary status.
Do not merge an unexplained compiler-control construct merely because it reaches 100%.
Do not describe a blind-recovery trial as reproducible unless its evidence, frozen candidate, compared assembly, hashes, source commit, and deterministic score are preserved.
Promote accepted source through a fresh main-based recovery/* worktree containing only selected verified C blobs and no AI attribution.
